d:
In this episode, I explore the North Korea–China border, where I witnessed a side of North Korea that very few travelers get to see. From watching North Korean people going about their daily lives in the border city of Sinuiju to exploring the Broken Bridge, destroyed during the Korean War.
One of the most unforgettable moments was taking a boat tour on the Yalu (Amnok) River, where I got incredibly close to North Korea and even entered North Korean territorial waters.
